tools.name: arobi_authorize
tools.description: Decide whether an agent action is permitted against a sealed route grant, and seal an AUTHORIZATION record. Returns GRANTED, DENIED or ESCALATED with the reason. Call arobi_route_grant first to obtain the grant.

tools.name: arobi_route_grant
tools.description: Seal WHO granted WHAT authority to WHICH workflow, with scope, caps, attenuation and expiry. One grant authorises many later arobi_authorize decisions.

tools.name: arobi_classify_and_route
tools.description: Classify a prompt and choose the cheapest route CAPABLE of the work from your candidate set, reporting whether any cost above the cheapest capable route is justified by a named required capability, by measured quality under your explicit quality_exception policy, or by nothing. Also reports whether

tools.name: arobi_verify_chain
tools.description: Recompute a set of sealed spine records and report whether the hash chain is continuous, which record breaks it, and why. Verification only — it re-derives, it does not re-execute.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "arobi_authorize" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
